verdict.rationale: New Relic AI lets users ask questions and explore telemetry in plain language, and helps fix queries (docs-9, docs-10). The official MCP server converts plain-English questions into NRQL and returns results (docs-22). NRQL is the same language behind charts and dashboards (docs-47), so the core of the story, a natural-language question producing a real query, is clearly documented. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the in-app assistant returns a rendered chart (not just results), detailed first-party docs on the NL-to-NRQL behavior and its accuracy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
